decision.rationale: Calibration 004 is operationally invalid because a completed provider response violated the frozen atomic boundary invariant. Revoke authority and stop for an explicit reviewer-method decision rather than revising the same contract again.
limitations: Only twelve of forty controls received provider responses and only eight votes passed deterministic semantics before the stop.
Reviewer quality cannot be estimated because expected labels remained sealed.
No wording, T0 product, paired-control, or final 10,000-case evidence was produced.
